regulations.parking_requirements: No overnight parking on any town street from November 1 – May 1
regulations.notes: Winter Park requires STR registration before listing on Airbnb, VRBO, or similar platforms. Annual $150 registration fee paid via MuniRevs. Every owner must register even if using a property manager. East Grand Fire requires a Fire & Life Safety Inspection for all STRs. All registrations expire September 30 annually and are not pro-rated. Registration number must appear in all advertising.
